linux_gpiozero_motor_init.message0: initialize motor %1 forward pin %2 backward pin %3 output mode %4
linux_gpiozero_motor_init.tooltip: Create a gpiozero Motor using two driver input pins.

linux_gpiozero_motor_forward.tooltip: Run an initialized motor forward at a validated speed.

linux_gpiozero_motor_backward.tooltip: Run an initialized motor backward at a validated speed.

linux_gpiozero_motor_value.tooltip: Read the signed motor value from -1 backward to 1 forward.

linux_gpiozero_motor_close.tooltip: Stop, close, and release an initialized motor.

linux_gpiozero_angular_servo_init.message0: initialize angular servo %1 pin %2 minimum angle %3 maximum angle %4 initial angle %5
linux_gpiozero_angular_servo_init.tooltip: Create a gpiozero AngularServo with an explicit angle range.

linux_gpiozero_angular_servo_set.message0: set angular servo %1 angle to %2 degrees
linux_gpiozero_angular_servo_set.tooltip: Set the angle of an initialized AngularServo.

linux_gpiozero_angular_servo_read.tooltip: Read the commanded angle, or None after detach.

linux_gpiozero_angular_servo_detach.tooltip: Stop sending servo pulses without closing the GPIO device.

linux_gpiozero_angular_servo_close.tooltip: Detach, close, and release an AngularServo.

linux_gpiozero_distance_init.message0: initialize ultrasonic sensor %1 trigger pin %2 echo pin %3 maximum distance %4 m threshold %5 m
linux_gpiozero_distance_init.tooltip: Create a gpiozero DistanceSensor for an HC-SR04-compatible module.

linux_gpiozero_distance_read.tooltip: Read the measured distance in metres or centimetres.

linux_gpiozero_distance_in_range.tooltip: Whether the measured distance is below the configured threshold.

linux_gpiozero_distance_wait.message0: wait for ultrasonic sensor %1 to become %2 timeout %3 s (0 forever)
linux_gpiozero_distance_wait.tooltip: Wait for a threshold transition; timeout 0 waits without a limit.

linux_gpiozero_distance_close.tooltip: Close and release an ultrasonic DistanceSensor.

linux_gpiozero_rotary_init.message0: initialize rotary encoder %1 A pin %2 B pin %3 maximum steps %4 wrap %5
linux_gpiozero_rotary_init.tooltip: Create a gpiozero RotaryEncoder; maximum steps 0 is unbounded.

linux_gpiozero_rotary_steps.tooltip: Read the signed step count of a RotaryEncoder.

linux_gpiozero_rotary_reset.tooltip: Reset an initialized RotaryEncoder step count to zero.

linux_gpiozero_rotary_wait.message0: wait for rotary encoder %1 rotation %2 timeout %3 s (0 forever)
linux_gpiozero_rotary_wait.tooltip: Wait for rotation in the selected direction; timeout 0 waits forever.

linux_gpiozero_buzzer_init.tooltip: Create a gpiozero Buzzer or TonalBuzzer using an allowlisted mode.

linux_gpiozero_buzzer_play.tooltip: Play a note such as A4 on a tonal buzzer; a simple buzzer turns on.

linux_gpiozero_buzzer_on.tooltip: Turn on a simple buzzer, or play A4 on a tonal buzzer.

linux_gpiozero_buzzer_off.tooltip: Turn off or stop an initialized buzzer.

linux_gpiozero_buzzer_stop.tooltip: Stop an initialized simple or tonal buzzer.

linux_gpiozero_buzzer_close.tooltip: Stop, close, and release an initialized buzzer.
